title: Historical benefits billing and account-balance reconciliation
summary: Legacy benefits workbooks show recurring administrative reconciliation artifacts for dental/vision billing and FSA account balances. Subscriber/consumer rows remain restricted; only report structure and calculation definitions are generalized.

claims.claim: Consolidated dental/vision billing reports contain sections for Overview, Subscriber Listing, COBRA, Retro Update and Current Period Changes; observed versions also expose Claims Tax.
The billing detail schema includes client/subclient, product, subscriber identity, coverage type and total due, plus billing-period, previous/current billing and effective-date fields.
Observed coverage products include Delta Dental PPO plus Premier and an RTEC vision product.

The historical FSA report defines a pre-funded plan balance as election plus employer contribution plus wellness contribution plus incoming rollovers, less outgoing rollovers, plus plan-balance adjustments, less paid amounts, plus refunds, less pending amounts, debit-card preauthorizations, pending repayments and fees.

evidence.page_or_section: Report Key / plan year balance definition

claims.claim: For terminated elections, the historical report states that plan-year balance is calculated using a zero election and zero employer contribution rather than the last pre-termination values.

The report distinguishes pre-funded and accrual available-balance calculations; accrual plans use consumer deposits and employer deposits rather than election amounts, and the plan-year-balance column appears only for accrual plans.

steps: Reconcile plan/coverage changes, retroactivity, COBRA and current-period changes as applicable.
Keep subscriber/consumer details in restricted administrative handling rather than generalized knowledge.
decisions: Treat current report formulas and carrier billing rules as version-specific until current authority is verified.
exceptions: Multi-subscriber reports must not be filed as one employee's personnel document.
controls: Preserve report-level provenance while excluding subscriber/consumer rows from reusable knowledge.
Do not use SSN, subscriber ID, date of birth, individual balance, coverage amount or billed amount as reusable knowledge.
unresolved_questions: Which current systems/carriers now produce equivalent billing and account-balance reports?
Are the 2024 Delta Dental/vision workbook sections and retro-billing workflow still current?
Was the PY2016 FSA balance-report logic superseded by a newer administrator or plan design?
automation_candidates: Recognize multi-person benefits reports and route them to restricted benefits administration rather than employee-file scanning.
Reconcile current billing exports against enrollment/termination change logs once a current authoritative data source is connected.

provenance.page_or_section: report labels and calculation definitions only

provenance.notes: Three semantic-duplicate binary variants observed; no subscriber rows retained.
